name: Reusable TMs
author: PokePat
description: TMs are no longer used up when a Pokémon learns their move – like HMs and like in newer games. The bag shows no count next to TMs any more.

usage: Nothing to do – every TM stays in the bag after teaching. Give each TM only once (a second one has no use).
